# PyTexturePacker provenance

- Upstream: https://github.com/wo1fsea/PyTexturePacker
- Fork: https://github.com/zlatkok/PyTexturePacker

- Base version: 1.2.1

This version contains changes required by `assets/compileAssets.py`, including image scaling, duplicate and blank-image handling, atlas cropping, post-processing, and returning atlas metadata without saving it separately.
